assay_run.method: Aggregate Figure 5 comparison of CTRL and iPSC-EV-treated macrophage protein extracts; tryptic digestion, DDA-PASEF acquisition and MaxQuant 1.6.17.0 label-free analysis. Raw-file identities cannot be assigned to these groups. Article and PRIDE sample protocol specify nanoElute; PRIDE data-processing protocol also names Evosep One.

condition.time: Matched collection interval for the 24 h EV-treatment experiment.

sample.biological_source: Primary human PBMC-derived macrophages from healthy blood donors
sample.sample_material: Protein extract from source-labelled untreated control PBMC-derived macrophages for Figure 5 proteomics. Three independent experiments used biological duplicates, three PBMC donors and EVs from three producer-cell passages; individual preparation/file mappings are unavailable. The EV dose specifically assigned to the Figure 5 proteomics preparations is unresolved; the general protocol does not establish preparation-specific LPS/ATP assignments.

sample.biological_source: Primary human PBMC-derived macrophages from healthy blood donors
sample.sample_material: Protein extract from iPSC-EV-treated PBMC-derived macrophages for Figure 5 proteomics. Three independent experiments used biological duplicates, three PBMC donors and EVs from three producer-cell passages; individual preparation/file mappings are unavailable. EV producer: iPSC line WTSli028-A; this is reagent provenance, not macrophage donor identity. The EV dose specifically assigned to the Figure 5 proteomics preparations is unresolved; the general protocol does not establish preparation-specific LPS/ATP assignments.
